description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Leidos is hiring a Junior Full Stack Software Engineer to support the DHMSM contract’s modernization of electronic health record and virtual health capabilities. The role develops, deploys, and sustains full-stack services and user interfaces, while supporting operations and CI/CD automation.
Junior Full Stack Software Engineer building Java microservices and JavaScript/TypeScript UIs, supporting Kubernetes deployment and CI/CD automation

Responsibilities:
• Develop and support containerized microservices within a Kubernetes cluster
• Java development of microservices to implement new capabilities or enhance existing services
• JavaScript/Typescript development of UI capabilities
• Full stack implementation and support capabilities
• Creative problem solving of issues that arise in local and production environments
• Own tasks through analysis, implementation, and production deployment
• Work closely with Operations team to implement features and work in environments
• Support CI/CD automation related to services
• Create adequate and understandable documentation for services
• Communicate effectively across product, development, operations, and application security teams
• Leverage technical expertise and participate in the definition of new capabilities and the enhancement or troubleshooting of existing capabilities
• Ability to quickly ramp up on new technologies when encountered
• Work independently within a matrixed organization

Requirements:
• BS Degree and 1-4 years of prior relevant experience
• US Citizen with current US Government clearance; ability to obtain and maintain ADP2/IT2 Public Trust
• In depth technical understanding and strong development experience with:

Java (or similar Object-Oriented programming languages)
• JavaScript/Typescript/HTML/CSS
• JavaScript / Typescript / HTML / CSS (and related UI frameworks like Angular/React)
• AWS (or similar cloud provider)
• Linux (RHEL or Debian/Ubuntu)
• Scripting (Bash, Python)
• CI/CD automation (e.g. Gitlab, Jenkins)
• Automated unit and integration testing (e.g. Junit, Jasmine, Selenium)
• Strong verbal and written communications skills, with an ability to express complex technical concepts in business terms
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conceptual skills
• Strong interpersonal skills; ability to communicate and persuade at all management levels and thrive in a cross-functional environment
• Requirements interpretation and decomposition
• Agile software development (Kanban, Scrum), including testing

Preferred:
• DevOps and operational support experience
• Experience with EHR system infrastructure architecture and implementation
• Spring based microservices (or similar)
• REST API's (JSON, XML)
• Containerization (Docker)
• Container Orchestration (Kubernetes)
• Infrastructure as Code (Ansible, Terraform, Cloudformation)
• AWS Managed Services
• Static code analysis & quality (e.g. Sonarqube, Sqale, JArchitect, Fortify)
• Container/Artifact Registries (e.g. Nexus, Harbor)
